LorcanaJSON 2026-10-16 marks Q3 hasAllCards=false, although its 2026-10-10 changelog says all cards and reward cards were added. All 37 numbered Q3 cards and Vine Tendril are present; the false metadata flag is preserved.
Ink Drop counter objects are omitted by LorcanaJSON. The official rules say these are counters rather than cards; no fabricated card records were created.
Future unreleased sets 15 Into the Inkdark and 16 Cosmic Quest are excluded. Future C3 and December C2 distribution promos are not represented as available cards.
Source foilTypes represent official-app data and may be imperfect for Special cards. The exact source foilTypes remain available; only Normal/Foil groups are exposed as variants.
Cardmarket trend prices are marketplace-wide EUR aggregates, not condition- or language-specific quotes. Only exact product IDs and existing finish series with positive values are used.
Lorcast does not publish a per-price update timestamp. Its optional USD market prices carry updated=null and observedAt; these are not represented as newly updated quotes.
